lines.zh: 我贴着冷水底游，几乎不留影。
lines.en: I swim along the cold bottom, barely leaving a shadow.

lines.zh: 我只有二十几厘米，游得很快。
lines.en: I am twenty-odd centimetres long and fast.

lines.zh: 河底的卵石滑，我顺着滑。
lines.en: The river cobbles are slick and I slide along them.

lines.zh: 我游过月光落下的那一片水。
lines.en: I cross the patch of water where moonlight lands.

lines.zh: 我拐得很急，鳞光一闪就没了。
lines.en: I turn sharply and a flash of scale is gone.

lines.zh: 冷水让我清醒，我越游越远。
lines.en: Cold water keeps me sharp and I swim farther.

lines.zh: 我在石缝间穿，像一滴银子。
lines.en: I thread the rock cracks like a drop of silver.

lines.zh: 水面结着薄冰，我在下面走。
lines.en: Thin ice skins the surface and I travel beneath it.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，就游出你的视线。
lines.en: One flick of my tail takes me out of sight.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，避开亮处。
lines.en: I follow the bank and avoid the bright water.

lines.zh: 夜里我才出来，白天躲着。
lines.en: I come out at night and hide by day.

lines.zh: 我游得无声，连水草都不动。
lines.en: I swim without sound, not even stirring the weeds.

lines.zh: 我从湖心游向河口，一路不停。
lines.en: I swim from lake centre to river mouth without stopping.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛反着月光，很亮。
lines.en: My eyes catch the moonlight and shine.

lines.zh: 我从水草间穿过，一根也没碰断。
lines.en: I pass through the weeds without breaking one.

lines.zh: 河底的沙很细，我贴着它滑。
lines.en: The river sand is fine; I slide just above it.

lines.zh: 同族在前面转，我跟上队尾。
lines.en: My kin turn ahead; I take the tail of the line.

lines.zh: 一有响动，我们整群散开。
lines.en: At the first sound, the whole school scatters.

lines.zh: 我停在水底，眼睛还睁着。
lines.en: I stop on the bottom with my eyes still open.

lines.zh: 冷得像冰的水，我待着不动。
lines.en: In water cold as ice I hold still.

lines.zh: 我在等一只落水的虫子。
lines.en: I am waiting for a bug to fall in.

lines.zh: 石头缝里很安全，我不出去。
lines.en: The rock crevice is safe and I stay inside.

lines.zh: 我的鳃慢慢开合，很轻。
lines.en: My gills open and close, very gently.

lines.zh: 月亮升到头顶，我才浮起来。
lines.en: Only when the moon is overhead do I rise.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，它一浮上去就破。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and it bursts on the way up.

lines.zh: 这条河里，几乎没人见过我。
lines.en: Almost nobody has seen me in this river.

lines.zh: 我贴着石面，像一片白鳞。
lines.en: I press to the stone like a white scale.

lines.zh: 我听着岸上的脚步，不动。
lines.en: I listen to footsteps on the bank and do not move.

lines.zh: 水草在我旁边摇，我不摇。
lines.en: The weeds sway beside me; I do not.

lines.zh: 我把自己藏在倒影里。
lines.en: I hide myself inside the reflection.

lines.zh: 我又躲过了一个打鱼的人。
lines.en: I have dodged another fisherman.

lines.zh: 夜还长，我不急着走。
lines.en: The night is long and I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你的灯照下来，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Your lamp shines down and I squint.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里看你，你不该看见我。
lines.en: I watch from the crevice; you should not see me.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住水面，我沉下去。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the water and I sink.

lines.zh: 我抬头，眼睛正对着你的灯。
lines.en: I look up and my eyes meet your lamp.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，我就在你脚下。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank and I am right below.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你一直没发现。
lines.en: I watched you a long time and you never noticed.

lines.zh: 你在找鱼，我就在这。
lines.en: You are looking for fish; here I am.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛亮了一下，你眨眼了。
lines.en: My eye flashes and you blink.

lines.zh: 你把手伸进水里，我退开。
lines.en: You reach into the water and I draw back.

lines.zh: 你终于和我对上了眼。
lines.en: At last our eyes meet.

lines.zh: 我太薄了，这一下几乎要了我的命。
lines.en: I am so fragile that blow nearly killed me.

lines.zh: 我翻白了，又拼命游起来。
lines.en: I turn belly-up, then force myself to swim.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，像一小片云。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water like a small cloud.

lines.zh: 我被打得撞上石头，鳞没了。
lines.en: The hit slams me into stone and strips my scales.

lines.zh: 我游得歪歪扭扭，眼睛还睁着。
lines.en: I swim crooked, eyes still open.

lines.zh: 疼，我只有两点的命。
lines.en: It hurts; I have only two points of life.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝，尾巴还露在外面。
lines.en: I dive into a crevice with my tail still out.

lines.zh: 水变红了，我不敢回头。
lines.en: The water reddens and I dare not look back.

lines.zh: 我拼命拍尾，只想离你远点。
lines.en: I beat my tail hard, just wanting distance.

lines.zh: 你这一下，够我记很久。
lines.en: That blow of yours will stay with me a while.

lines.zh: 虫子落水了，我没忍住。
lines.en: A bug fell in and I could not resist.

lines.zh: 那点腥味，在冷水里很清楚。
lines.en: That hint of fishiness is clear in the cold water.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵转，先看了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the bait and look it over once.

lines.zh: 我知道有钩，可天太冷了。
lines.en: I know there is a hook, but it is so cold.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又合上。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then close it.

lines.zh: 这点食不够我冒险，但我还是来了。
lines.en: That is not worth the risk, yet here I am.

lines.zh: 我用唇碰饵，钩子在下面。
lines.en: I touch the bait with my lips; the hook is beneath.

lines.zh: 你手一抖，我退了半尺。
lines.en: Your hand shakes and I back off half a foot.

lines.zh: 冷得我饿，饿得我忘了怕。
lines.en: Cold makes me hungry, and hunger makes me forget fear.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，水一下变重了。
lines.en: I bite, and the water suddenly gets heavy.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你靴上，滑开了。
lines.en: I bump your boot head-first and slide off.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，我撞上你的脚踝。
lines.en: You step into the water and I hit your ankle.

lines.zh: 我撞到石头，鳞掉了一小片。
lines.en: I hit a stone and lose a small scale.

lines.zh: 水草缠了我一下，我挣开了。
lines.en: A weed caught me and I broke free.

lines.zh: 你的网擦过我，我躲得够快。
lines.en: Your net grazed me; I was quick enough.

lines.zh: 两只鱼撞在一起，各自弹开。
lines.en: Two fish collide and both bounce apart.

lines.zh: 我蹭过船底，声音很小。
lines.en: I brush the boat hull with a tiny sound.

lines.zh: 水流把我推到岸边，我又游回去。
lines.en: The current pushes me ashore and I swim back.

lines.zh: 我撞上水桶，桶壁震了一下。
lines.en: I hit a bucket and its wall thuds.

lines.zh: 我被撞得打转，眼睛还在看。
lines.en: I spin from the knock, eyes still watching.

lines.zh: 我绕着她游，一圈比一圈小。
lines.en: I circle her in ever smaller rings.

lines.zh: 这条河里，我们两个都很少见。
lines.en: In this river both of us are rare sights.

lines.zh: 她比我小一圈，眼睛更亮。
lines.en: She is a size smaller with brighter eyes.

lines.zh: 月光照进浅滩，我贴着它游。
lines.en: Moonlight reaches the shallows; I swim close against it.

lines.zh: 我用尾鳍碰她，她没躲。
lines.en: I touch her with my tail and she does not flinch.

lines.zh: 月亮够亮了，我们才配对。
lines.en: The moon was bright enough, so we paired.

lines.zh: 配完对，我们各自藏回石缝。
lines.en: After pairing we each slip back into a crevice.

lines.zh: 最深的那个河湾，我留给她。
lines.en: The deepest bend of the river, I keep for her.

lines.zh: 我们并排游了很短一段。
lines.en: We swim side by side for a short stretch.

lines.zh: 她也和我一样，不爱说话。
lines.en: She, like me, says little.

lines.zh: 我叼起一颗掉落的石子，又放了。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen pebble and put it down.

lines.zh: 水底有片亮东西，我叼走藏起来。
lines.en: Something bright on the bottom, I carry it off to hide.

lines.zh: 我捡起半只虫子，吞不下去。
lines.en: I pick up half a bug and cannot swallow it.

lines.zh: 我咬住一片鳞，游回石缝。
lines.en: I take a scale in my mouth and swim back to the crevice.

lines.zh: 我把一片鳞藏进石缝。
lines.en: I tuck a scale into the rock crack.

lines.zh: 我拖着一根水草，游得歪。
lines.en: Dragging a weed, I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 我捡到一枚硬币，咬着很凉。
lines.en: I find a coin and it tastes cold.

lines.zh: 我抱着一小块面包，慢慢啃。
lines.en: I hold a scrap of bread and nibble slowly.

lines.zh: 这块玻璃不错，我收着。
lines.en: This bit of glass is good; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我藏好东西，回头看了三次。
lines.en: I hide my find and look back three times.

lines.zh: 水面有虫子掉了，我锁定了。
lines.en: A bug fell on the surface and I have it.

lines.zh: 我看见你的饵沉下来。
lines.en: I see your bait sinking.

lines.zh: 一点动静，我头就转过去。
lines.en: A small stir and my head turns.

lines.zh: 你的灯晃了一下，我看准了。
lines.en: Your lamp sways and I take aim.

lines.zh: 有东西在石缝里动，我盯住。
lines.en: Something moves in the crevice and I fix on it.

lines.zh: 我听见落水声，立刻游过去。
lines.en: I hear a splash and swim over at once.

lines.zh: 我盯上了那根细细的线。
lines.en: I have my eye on that thin line.

lines.zh: 岸上有影子，我锁定了。
lines.en: A shadow on the bank, and I lock on.

lines.zh: 我看准了那片月光下的水。
lines.en: I fix on the moonlit patch of water.

lines.zh: 目标不远，我开始加速。
lines.en: The target is near, and I accelerate.

lines.zh: 我贴着你脚边的石头，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I hug the stone by your feet and edge closer.

lines.zh: 我在饵下方盘旋，等你松手。
lines.en: I hover under the bait, waiting for you to let go.

lines.zh: 我亮着眼睛，一寸寸靠近。
lines.en: Eyes bright, I close in inch by inch.

lines.zh: 你动一下，我就停一下。
lines.en: You shift, and I stop.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准钩，先闻了闻。
lines.en: I aim my mouth at the hook and sniff first.

lines.zh: 水面很静，我不想弄出声音。
lines.en: The surface is calm and I want no sound.

lines.zh: 我再近半寸，就够到了。
lines.en: Half an inch more and I can reach it.

lines.zh: 我在你影子里，你看不见我。
lines.en: I am in your shadow; you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我等了很久，才决定动手。
lines.en: I waited a long time before deciding.

lines.zh: 我数着水滴落下的节奏。
lines.en: I count the rhythm of dripping water.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，力气小得可怜。
lines.en: I bump you with pitiful force.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬线，牙很快崩了。
lines.en: I bite the line and my teeth chip.

lines.zh: 我拍尾巴，水花溅到你脸上。
lines.en: I slap my tail and splash your face.

lines.zh: 我扑上来，只是一条小鱼的重量。
lines.en: I lunge with the weight of one small fish.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的手指，立刻松开。
lines.en: I bite your finger and let go at once.

lines.zh: 我拿头撞你，撞得自己发晕。
lines.en: I headbutt you and daze myself.

lines.zh: 我缠在你手上，滑得抓不住。
lines.en: I wrap your hand, too slick to grip.

lines.zh: 这一下连痒都算不上。
lines.en: That barely even tickles.

lines.zh: 我把你往水里拉，根本拉不动。
lines.en: I try to pull you in and move you not at all.

lines.zh: 我咬住钩，往后拼命挣。
lines.en: I bite the hook and strain backward.

lines.zh: 冷水的夜里，我从石缝钻出来。
lines.en: On a cold night I slip out of the rock crack.

lines.zh: 我出生时只有这么长，现在也是。
lines.en: I was this small at birth, and still am.

lines.zh: 河面浮着月光，我在下面睁眼。
lines.en: Moonlight floats on the river and I open my eyes below.

lines.zh: 我从湖底的暗处慢慢升起。
lines.en: I rise slowly from the dark lakebed.

lines.zh: 没有人看见我出生，这很正常。
lines.en: Nobody saw me born, which is normal.

lines.zh: 我游进河流，身后什么也没留。
lines.en: I swim into the river leaving nothing behind.

lines.zh: 我是一片冷水养大的。
lines.en: Cold water raised me.

lines.zh: 第一口呼吸，冰得我发抖。
lines.en: My first breath is so cold I shiver.

lines.zh: 我从倒影里浮出来，很轻。
lines.en: I surface out of the reflection, very light.

lines.zh: 这条河太安静，我几乎没吵醒它。
lines.en: The river is so quiet I barely wake it.

lines.zh: 火烫到水，我在下面都觉得灼。
lines.en: The fire heats the water and I feel scorched below.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下来，摔得很轻。
lines.en: I drop from the surface and land lightly.

lines.zh: 我一直在水里，可这一口真的喘不上。
lines.en: I have always been in water, yet this breath fails.

lines.zh: 爆炸的震波把我掀到水面。
lines.en: The blast wave throws me to the surface.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，鳞落了一片。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my back and a scale falls.

lines.zh: 药水把整条河都染了色，我头晕。
lines.en: Potion dyes the whole river and my head swims.

lines.zh: 冷水里没虫，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: No bugs in the cold water and hunger makes me frantic.

lines.zh: 雷打进河里，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river and numbs me all over.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，也没有月亮。
lines.en: The void has no water and no moon.
